facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.justification: MOC-2005-0014 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 9 January 2005 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to relax a key safeguard requirement, and the basis for the relaxation is recorded with the change. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: This change relaxes a control: 0 steps of relaxation are recorded against it, and the residual risk position rests on that relaxation having been accepted deliberately.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2009-003, PRO-MEC-055 and STD-LFT-003.
